mapper.sql: id, registration_id, division_id, season_id, team_id, player_id, member_id, platform_identity_id, platform_code, game_id_snapshot, player_name_snapshot, position, jersey_no, is_captain, is_starter, sort_order, create_time, update_time, is_delete
mapper.select: select from basket_registration_player where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
select from basket_registration_player where is_delete = 0 order by sort_order asc, id asc

select rp.player_id, coalesce(nullif(trim(mp.nickname), ''), nullif(trim(p.game_nickname), ''), rp.player_name_snapshot) as player_name_snapshot, rp.game_id_snapshot, rp.platform_code, rp.position, rp.jersey_no, rp.is_captain, rp.is_starter, rp.is_delete, case when tm.id is null then 0 else 1 end as current_member from basket_registration_player rp left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = rp.player_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = p.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 left join basket_registration r on r.id = rp.registration_id left join basket_team_member tm on tm.team_id = r.team_id and tm.player_id = rp.player_id and tm.is_current = 1 and tm.membership_status = 1 and tm.is_delete = 0 where rp.registration_id = #{registrationId} order by rp.is_delete asc, current_member desc, rp.sort_order asc, rp.id asc
select from basket_registration_player where registration_id = #{registrationId} and is_delete = 0 order by sort_order asc, id asc
mapper.insert:
insert into basket_registration_player ( registration_id, division_id, season_id, team_id, player_id, member_id, platform_identity_id, platform_code, game_id_snapshot, player_name_snapshot, position, jersey_no, is_captain, is_starter, sort_order, create_time, update_time, is_delete ) values
(#{item.registrationId}, #{item.divisionId}, #{item.seasonId}, #{item.teamId}, #{item.playerId}, #{item.memberId}, #{item.platformIdentityId}, #{item.platformCode}, #{item.gameIdSnapshot}, #{item.playerNameSnapshot}, #{item.position}, #{item.jerseyNo}, #{item.isCaptain}, #{item.isStarter}, #{item.sortOrder}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.isDelete})
mapper.update:
update basket_registration_player
registration_id = #{registrationId}, division_id = #{divisionId}, season_id = #{seasonId}, team_id = #{teamId}, player_id = #{playerId}, member_id = #{memberId}, platform_identity_id = #{platformIdentityId}, platform_code = #{platformCode}, game_id_snapshot = #{gameIdSnapshot}, player_name_snapshot = #{playerNameSnapshot}, position = #{position}, jersey_no = #{jerseyNo}, is_captain = #{isCaptain}, is_starter = #{isStarter}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, update_time = now()
where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
update basket_registration_player set is_delete = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
mapper.select: select m.player_id as playerId, p.player_no as playerNo, coalesce(mp.nickname, p.game_nickname) as nickname from basket_team_member m left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = m.player_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = m.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 where m.team_id = #{teamId} and m.is_current = 1 and m.membership_status = 1 and m.is_delete = 0 and not exists ( select 1 from basket_registration_player rp where rp.registration_id = #{registrationId} and rp.player_id = m.player_id and rp.is_delete = 0 ) order by case when m.role_type = 'CAPTAIN' then 0 else 1 end, m.join_time asc
select count(1) from basket_registration_player where registration_id = #{registrationId} and is_delete = 0
select count(1) from basket_team_member where team_id = #{teamId} and player_id = #{playerId} and is_current = 1 and membership_status = 1 and is_delete = 0

select count(1) from basket_registration_player rp inner join basket_registration r on r.id = rp.registration_id and r.is_delete = 0 inner join basket_team_member tm on tm.team_id = r.team_id and tm.player_id = rp.player_id and tm.is_current = 1 and tm.membership_status = 1 and tm.is_delete = 0 where rp.registration_id = #{registrationId} and rp.is_delete = 0

select count(1) from basket_registration_player rp inner join basket_registration r on r.id = rp.registration_id and r.is_delete = 0 inner join basket_division d on d.id = r.division_id and d.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team_member tm on tm.team_id = r.team_id and tm.player_id = rp.player_id and tm.is_current = 1 and tm.membership_status = 1 and tm.is_delete = 0 where rp.is_delete = 0 and rp.division_id = #{divisionId} and rp.player_id = #{playerId} and r.registration_status in ('PENDING_REVIEW', 'APPROVED') and ( d.division_status in ('FINISHED', 'ARCHIVED') or exists ( select 1 from basket_match m where m.division_id = r.division_id and m.is_delete = 0 and m.match_status in ('PLAYING', 'FINISHED', 'FORFEITED') ) or exists ( select 1 from basket_match_player_stat s where s.division_id = r.division_id and s.is_delete = 0 ) or exists ( select 1 from basket_match_submission_player_stat ss where ss.division_id = r.division_id and ss.is_delete = 0 ) or tm.id is not null ) and r.id != #{excludeRegistrationId}
